responsibility: This is the master machine description for the MIPS backend. It defines the processor enum, shared UNSPECs, attributes, core instruction patterns, peepholes, move and branch machinery, synchronization and call patterns, and then includes the extension-specific .md files for sync, paired-single/MIPS-3D, DSP, DSPr2, fixed-point, microMIPS, Loongson MMI, and MSA, making it the central RTL instruction-selection specification for all MIPS code generation in GCC.
same_name_distinction: Within the mips same-name group, this file is the machine-description source for instruction selection and scheduling metadata: it defines RTL patterns, attributes, UNSPECs, and includes extension-specific .md files, instead of providing C/C++ declarations in mips.h, executable backend code in mips.cc, or option definitions in mips.opt.
